scope.statement: For the actual Section-165 plateau response and Section-175 locked fan, an admissible-basis population inequality gives an integrated sufficient criterion for Xi(v) >= j_*(v) + |T_Z(v)| at some generic phase.
scope.domain: Proof for every actual response satisfying the cited canonical hypotheses; exact finite regression controls use the 18 Section-102-admissible seed-63 ledgers and 34 seed-66 full-tube cases pinned in SOURCES.json.
scope.limitations: The sufficient area criterion is not proved for every global source. The seed fixtures have no canonical source demand and are not global-source counterexamples; zero-slack and Level I remain open.

result: Proved an exact phase-integrated lower bound for the Section-175 residual, retaining the admissible-basis deep nullity and shield-terminal counts; replayed its pointwise population inequality on corrected predecessor ledgers.
remaining_questions: Derive the sufficient population condition from global source geometry for every sufficiently large actual source, or prove a stronger lower bound for the expected sector sink surplus when that condition fails.
